question: Madan starts from point A and drives 4 km towards the South. He then takes a left turn and drives 5 km. he then takes a right turn and drives 2 km. He then takes another right turn and drives 3 km. He takes a final right turn and drives 6 km to reach point B. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified)
solution:
**Given**:

Madan starts from point A and drives 4 km towards the South.

He then takes a left turn and drives 5 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 2 km.

He then takes another right turn and drives 3 km.

He takes a final right turn and drives 6 km to reach point B. 

Based on this, we get the final direction distance diagram as follows-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5609ddec4bcb75b8293ed6c5e4101058bb8edb30e2ab59c1b5096e8bc9591d2a.png] 

Therefore, we can clearly see that to go from point B to point A, he has to drive 2 kms to the West.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
